column1: # The tesseract language models the OCR bundle carries and devenv and CI read with, from tessdata_fast at
# TESSDATA_COMMIT: orientation and script detection; script/Latin, script/Greek, script/Cyrillic and script/Armenian,
# which read a page before its language is known; a model for every national language of Europe the language detector
# tells apart (MODEL_BY_LANGUAGE), which the automatic OCR language reads a page with once its language is detected;
# and a model for each other script it reads (LANGUAGE_BY_SCRIPT). Model path, then SHA-256.
